name: Timor-Leste
shortSummary: India established relations with Timor-Leste following its 2002 independence; ties remain limited but positive, with India supporting its integration into regional forums.

majorAreasOfCooperation.description: India has offered training slots and development cooperation as Timor-Leste builds state institutions.

sources.title: Bilateral brief
sources.publisher: Ministry of External Affairs, Government of India
